prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Iron Nation, of the Rust House. A female personification character with an old rusted iron armor — plates flaking into orange-brown rust, worn leather straps as her motif — she WEARS it as her own costume at full scale, never as a separate prop in her hands; add no other gear. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Iron (Fe) to carry in her design and the scene: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood. Palette: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
HOUSE TRAITS of Rust: flaking orange-brown rust over pitted dark iron, layered patina creeping over metal, worn leather straps, the look of something buried and dug up. Palette: rust orange, ochre, dark pitted iron, faded leather brown.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: broad-shouldered and strong build; twin tails; rust-orange hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): round face; soft droopy eyes; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; rust-amber eyes.
WORLD — FANTASY: a fantasy kingdom of smiths: a mountain fortress built around a great forge, rivers of molten iron glowing in channels, hammered-iron gates, anvils as altars, iron filings drawn into patterns by magic magnetism, ember sparks in the air. A hill fort smithy of the early Iron Age: a stone forge, bog-iron bloom, hammered bars, a wooden palisade and autumn hills. COSTUME (citizen, fantasy): her object leads — its silhouette, parts and materials must read at first glance in her outfit and headpiece, the object reimagined as cloth, forged pieces and ornament; the fantasy era only sets the period cut and finish — cloth, leather, forged metal, subtle magical glow. No corset, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or a short hem where the outfit allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the object's shape, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
source: 생성기 조립 그대로 — 철나라 주민 첫 묶음(2026-10-31, 기본 화풍 2.5D). 머리색은 물건 재질, 머리·얼굴형·눈은 가문주와 다르게, 옷은 물건이 먼저. 메모가 없는 세계는 장면 변주로 배경을 갈랐다
